why_ai: Approvals are already automated in milliseconds; only lending capital and regulation sustain the firm.
why_clarity: Millions of near-identical approvals with repayment outcomes observed within six weeks.
why_digital: Device and payment data in, credit inside an online checkout, consumers acquired remotely.

why_ai: Winning requires negotiating a consortium among competitors, bureaus and regulators, which no model solves.
why_clarity: A one-off coordination contest with no agreed method and terms still in dispute.
why_digital: Data infrastructure work, but bought through sector leadership and regulator negotiations in rooms.

why_ai: Adjudicating conflicting accounts is adversarial, but evidence assembly and decisions are automatable.
why_clarity: Hundreds of similar disputes weekly, yet the true facts usually stay unknown.
why_digital: Claims and merchant evidence handled on screen; underlying facts concern physical delivery of goods.

why_ai: Hardship signals sit in the repayment record and a model replaces disclosure-based detection.
why_clarity: Predicting missed payments on large uniform data with outcomes visible in weeks.
why_digital: Repayment data in, risk flags out, entirely inside provider systems.

why_ai: Account manager relationships matter, but placement tuning is testable and automatable.
why_clarity: Conversion is measured and A/B testable, though every merchant checkout differs.
why_digital: Dashboards, integrations and online checkouts end to end.

why_ai: Value rests on a proprietary repayment dataset of thin-file consumers that AI cannot replicate.
why_clarity: Open research question about what repayment predicts, with outcomes accruing over time.
why_digital: Large repayment datasets in, scores and insight out, sold to data buyers remotely.

why_ai: Rule-based reconciliation between return events and instalment schedules is pure software work.
why_clarity: Each return scenario has a deterministic correct schedule that is instantly checkable.
why_digital: Two system records reconciled in software with digital refunds out.

why_ai: Hardship conversations need care, but small-balance economics push collections to AI voice agents.
why_clarity: Recovery rates are measurable across a queue of near-identical small balances.
why_digital: Queue data in and phone or message contact out, run remotely.

why_ai: Aggregating schedules and forecasting payments is exactly what AI finance assistants deliver.
why_clarity: Total committed obligations and due dates are exact and verifiable against payments.
why_digital: Account data in, an app view out, used entirely online.

why_ai: Decisioning is itself a modelling contest, adversarial on fraud but executed by machines.
why_clarity: Repaid or not is unambiguous and arrives within weeks, though modelling science varies.
why_digital: Device, behaviour and basket signals in, an automated decision out.

why_clarity: Loss and approval rates are exact and outcomes arrive within weeks at huge volume.
why_digital: Checkout data in, an instant automated credit decision out.
